label: g9-probe-base
command:
"""ORCH-744 G9 probe: at git ref argv[1], does the committed gold, read by the
evaluator's own loader, certify exactly three complete cases, and does the committed
sample report score no PMC12657337 leg? Exit 0 iff yes. Reads git blobs only; the
one file it writes is a scratch copy of the gold blob outside the repository."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from t2pw.bench.eval_v2.gold import load_supplement

ref = sys.argv[1]
show = lambda p: subprocess.run(["git", "show", f"{ref}:{p}"], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout  # noqa: E731
tmp = Path("C:/t/bt/eval744/g9") / f"{ref}.json"
tmp.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
tmp.write_bytes(show("src/t2pw/bench/eval_v2/gold_v2_supported_reactions.json"))
complete = sorted(pid for pid, c in load_supplement(tmp).items() if c.complete)
rep = json.loads(show("docs/evaluation_v2/sample_report.json").decode("utf-8"))
legs = [l["leg_dir"] for l in rep["reaction_metrics"]["legs"] if l["target_paper"] == "PMC12657337"]
split = [s["leg_dir"] for s in rep["rag_archived_failure_split"]["legs"] if s["target_paper"] == "PMC12657337"]
fb = rep["reaction_metrics"]["aggregate"]["fallback"]
print("ref", ref, "| complete by loader:", complete, "| report complete_cases:", rep["gold_supplement"]["complete_cases"])
print("PMC12657337 reaction legs scored:", len(legs), "| archived-split legs:", len(split),
      "| fallback legs:", fb["legs"], "P", fb["precision_num_den"], "unsupported", fb["unsupported_num_den"])
want = ["PMC12096016", "PMC12312563", "PMC12421875"]
ok = complete == want and rep["gold_supplement"]["complete_cases"] == want and not legs and not split
print("D-103 HOLDS" if ok else "D-103 VIOLATED")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
